roadmap.title: Campaign
roadmap.description: Play the story from the Prologue to Mission 7. Do the mission-specific unlocks (Lictor, Ravener, Lesser Sorcerer, Scarab Occult Terminator, the Mission 6 drop) as you reach them, use Righteous Fury and finishers freely, and replay a mission for anything missed.

roadmap.title: Operations missions and collectibles
roadmap.description: Complete Operations 01-06 for the six auto-unlocks. While doing them, mark every enemy type, pick up the remaining Dataslates, and collect the barrel and reinforcement-call kills.

roadmap.title: Operations grinds
roadmap.description: Replay Operations to level classes and weapons, finish one Ruthless mission, and complete the per-class kill counters and the Tyranid and Chaos kill counters.

roadmap.title: Eternal War
roadmap.description: Play the PvP matches: win with each class, play 10 matches in each of the three modes, and get a 5-kill streak.

roadmap.title: Kill totals and finish
roadmap.description: Reach 20,000 and 41,000 total kills across all modes. Defender of Humanity unlocks after the other 49.

achievements.description: Become a Primaris Space Marine.
achievements.summary: Watch the cutscene in the opening mission where Titus rises as a Primaris Space Marine.

steps.text: Play the opening mission to the end. The achievement unlocks after the cutscene where Titus becomes a Primaris Space Marine.

achievements.description: Use the anti-aircraft batteries to destroy the hive ship.
achievements.summary: Destroy the hive ship by retaking the anti-aircraft batteries in the story.

steps.text: Follow the story until you retake the anti-aircraft batteries and destroy the hive ship.

achievements.description: Destroy the Tyranid swarm with a bomb in the promethium well.
achievements.summary: Complete Operation 01: Inferno by deploying the bomb in the promethium well.

steps.text: Play @loc{Operation 01: Inferno}.
Deploy the bomb in the promethium well to finish the mission.

achievements.description: Find out that Chaos forces are on Kadaku.
achievements.summary: Reach the crashed dropship in the story and find the Chaos forces on Kadaku.

steps.text: Follow the story to the crashed dropship. The achievement unlocks when you reach the ship.

achievements.description: Find where Morias Leuze is.
achievements.summary: Reach the facility in the story and protect its core from destruction to locate Morias Leuze.

steps.text: Follow the story to the facility and defend the core until the attack ends.

achievements.description: Save Morias Leuze from the Chaos attack.
achievements.summary: Fight through the Chaos heretics in the story and rescue Morias Leuze.

steps.text: Follow the story and fight through the heretics until you reach and rescue Morias Leuze.

achievements.description: Kill the Hive Tyrant.
achievements.summary: Complete Operation 02: Decapitation by killing the Hive Tyrant.

steps.text: Play @loc{Operation 02: Decapitation} and kill the @enemy{Hive Tyrant}.

achievements.description: Kill the Daemonhost and restore vox communication.
achievements.summary: Complete Operation 03: Vox Liberatis by killing the Daemonhost and restoring vox communication.

steps.text: Play @loc{Operation 03: Vox Liberatis}, kill the @enemy{Daemonhost}, and restore vox communication.

achievements.description: Defeat the Chaos sorcerer.
achievements.summary: Expose the traitors and kill the Chaos sorcerer in the story.

steps.text: Follow the story, expose the traitors, and kill the Chaos sorcerer.

achievements.description: Destroy the Chaos warp beacon.
achievements.summary: Complete Operation 04: Reliquary by destroying the Chaos warp beacon.

steps.text: Play @loc{Operation 04: Reliquary} and destroy the Chaos warp beacon.

achievements.description: Bring the Sword of Atreus back to life.
achievements.summary: Complete Operation 05: Fall of Atreus by reanimating the Sword of Atreus.

steps.text: Play @loc{Operation 05: Fall of Atreus} and reanimate the @item{Sword of Atreus}.

achievements.description: Hit 10 objects while dropping from orbit.
achievements.summary: Collide with 10 objects while dropping from orbit at the start of Mission 6: Dawn's Descent.

guide.context: Missions can be replayed, so you can retry the drop.

steps.text: Start @loc{Mission 6: Dawn's Descent}.
During the drop, steer into the space debris. Do not dodge it.
Hit 10 objects before the drop ends.

achievements.description: Learn what the Aurora device really is.
achievements.summary: Find out what the Aurora device really is in Mission 6: Dawn's Descent.

steps.text: In @loc{Mission 6: Dawn's Descent}, descend through the tomb to its lowest level and find Aurora.
Watch every cutscene in the mission. Skipping one stops the unlock.

achievements.description: Survive and defeat the Chaos invasion.
achievements.summary: Join up with the main army in the story and close the Chaos warp gates.

steps.text: Follow the story, meet the main army, and close the Chaos warp gates.

achievements.description: Defeat the Lord of Change and see a figure from the past.
achievements.summary: Beat the Lord of Change and confront a figure from the past at the end of the story.

steps.text: Follow the story to the end and beat the @enemy{Lord of Change}. The achievement unlocks once you confront a figure from the past.

achievements.description: Mark every enemy type
achievements.summary: Mark every enemy type at least once.

guide.context: Marks sometimes fail to register. Imurah, the Hive Tyrant, the Helldrake and the Carnifex are the usual last ones missing, so mark these again on a later run if the achievement does not unlock. Buying an enemy's entry in the Research Center shows a small icon that says whether you marked that enemy.

steps.text: In the campaign, mark each Tyranid type: @enemy{Hormagaunt}, @enemy{Termagant}, @enemy{Ravener}, @enemy{Lictor}, @enemy{Zoanthrope}, @enemy{Neurothrope}, @enemy{Carnifex}, and the Warriors with Lash Whip, Bone Sword, Venom Cannon, Barbed Strangler and Devourer.

In the campaign, mark each Chaos type: @enemy{Cultist}, Cultist with Las Cannon, @enemy{Tzaangor}, Rubric Marine with Inferno Bolter, Rubric Marine with Warp Flamer, @enemy{Lesser Sorcerer}, Scarab Occult Terminator with Soul Reaper, Scarab Occult Terminator with Sword, and @enemy{Helbrute}.
Mark @enemy{Imurah} in his Mission 5 fight and again in his Mission 7 fight.
In Operations, mark the @enemy{Hive Tyrant} in Operation 02: Decapitation and the @enemy{Helldrake} in Operation 04: Reliquary.
Spore Mines, Gargoyles, Ripper Swarms, Daemonhosts and Daemons cannot be marked. Skip them.

achievements.description: Perform 50 unique Finishers
achievements.summary: Perform 50 unique Finishers.

steps.text: Execute enemies whenever the game lets you, and finish enemies after a @mechanic{Perfect Parry}.
Swap melee weapons and fight many enemy types. Each enemy type and each melee weapon has its own finisher animations.

achievements.description: Collect all Dataslates
achievements.summary: Collect all 35 Dataslates in the campaign and Operations missions.

guide.context: In the hub, press Tab and open the Dataslate repository to see which Dataslates you have collected. Missions can be replayed for any you miss.

collectibles.name: Plant-blocked swamp path
collectibles.location: Swamp near the start, a little past the weapon capsule
collectibles.method: Shoot the red cocoon on the left path that plants block, then follow the path.

collectibles.name: Broken bridge
collectibles.location: Before you meet the soldiers, at the destroyed bridge
collectibles.method: Cross the bridge and look on the far side.

collectibles.name: Crossroads stairs
collectibles.method: Climb the stairs to the upper level.

collectibles.name: Landing pad elevator
collectibles.location: Foot of the elevator that leads to the landing pad
collectibles.method: Check the bottom of the elevator.

collectibles.name: Ruined bunker
collectibles.location: Near the start of the level
collectibles.method: Search the ruined bunker.

collectibles.name: Roofless factory
collectibles.method: Go up the ramp and turn left.

collectibles.name: Abandoned camp
collectibles.location: Abandoned camp found during the story
collectibles.method: Look on the mountain by the abandoned camp.

collectibles.name: Citadel elevator
collectibles.location: After the boss, in the citadel
collectibles.method: Before you ride the elevator down, check near the elevator.

collectibles.name: Ventilation shaft
collectibles.location: Big staircase room after the room with rats
collectibles.method: Use the terminal to open the vent door, then follow the shaft to its end.

collectibles.name: Canyon ledge
collectibles.location: Swamp canyon before the last arena of the jungle's second part
collectibles.method: Look on a ledge in the rock.

collectibles.name: Bridge defence roof
collectibles.location: Across the way, during the bridge-opening defence
collectibles.method: Check the roof.

collectibles.name: Factory approach vent
collectibles.location: Corridors toward the factory, in an alley near the ruined bridge
collectibles.method: Look in the ventilation shaft.

collectibles.name: End-room corridor
collectibles.location: Entrance of the room with the mission-end elevator
collectibles.method: Go straight down the corridor from the front door.

collectibles.name: Right-hand fork
collectibles.method: Take the right corridor and check the fork on the right.

collectibles.name: Wagon arena tank
collectibles.method: Look near the destroyed tank.

collectibles.name: Elevator rear
collectibles.location: Near the elevator that takes you upstairs
collectibles.method: Check behind the elevator.

collectibles.name: Thassean temple tower
collectibles.method: Go straight instead of down the stairs and look behind the tower.

collectibles.name: Chapel balcony
collectibles.method: Check the balcony.

collectibles.name: Side vent shaft
collectibles.method: From the entry tunnel, go a little further, turn right, and follow the vent shaft.

collectibles.name: Upstairs left room
collectibles.location: At a fork where you would go down
collectibles.method: Take the stairs up instead, then step into the left-hand room.

collectibles.name: Circular arena floor
collectibles.method: Check the lower floor.

collectibles.name: Weapon pod room
collectibles.location: After powering up and opening the door
collectibles.method: Look in the room behind the weapon pod.

collectibles.name: Airlock floor
collectibles.method: Check the ruined floor above the second door.
collectibles.note: Check under the camera as well as above the door.

collectibles.name: Sector 5 exit
collectibles.method: Look to the right of the stairs at the section exit.

collectibles.name: Bookshelf
collectibles.method: Look near the bookshelf.

collectibles.name: Twin tower balcony
collectibles.location: Bridge with two towers after the arena
collectibles.method: Look on the first tower's right-hand balcony.

collectibles.name: Freight elevator arena
collectibles.method: Drop through the hole onto the freight elevator and search the arena.

collectibles.name: Spiral staircase top
collectibles.method: Climb to the top.

collectibles.name: Chapel corner
collectibles.method: Check around the corner of the chapel.

collectibles.name: Graveyard crypt
collectibles.method: Go down into the crypt.

collectibles.name: Bridge far side
collectibles.method: Cross the bridge and look on the far side.

collectibles.name: Second map section
collectibles.method: Follow the story route; you will walk past it.

collectibles.name: Catacombs
collectibles.method: Search the catacombs.

collectibles.name: Shrine corner
collectibles.location: Shrine area, en route to the second Force
collectibles.method: Check the far left corner.

collectibles.name: Citadel columns
collectibles.location: Citadel, after the cutscene with Calgar
collectibles.method: Turn right at the first circular corridor and look behind the ruined columns.

achievements.description: Kill 100 enemies using Righteous Fury
achievements.summary: Kill 100 enemies while using Righteous Fury.

guide.context: Righteous Fury is Titus's ability and works only in the campaign.

steps.text: In the campaign, press Q to use @mechanic{Righteous Fury} when swarms are close.
Keep killing during the ability until the total reaches 100.

achievements.description: Deliver a nova cannon warhead to the Tyranid position
achievements.summary: Complete Operation 06: Ballistic Engine by getting the nova cannon warhead to the Tyranid-held position.

steps.text: Play @loc{Operation 06: Ballistic Engine} and carry the nova cannon warhead to the Tyranids' position.

achievements.description: Complete any Mission in Operations mode on Ruthless Threat Level
achievements.summary: Complete any Operations mission on the Ruthless Threat Level.

guide.context: Ruthless is the hardest Threat Level. Level 20 is the recommended class level, but a strong squad can clear it much earlier.

steps.text: Pick any Operations mission and play it on the Ruthless Threat Level.
Finish the mission.

achievements.description: Reach the maximum Level for one Class
achievements.summary: Reach the maximum level, 25, for one class.

guide.context: A class earns XP when an Operation ends. Kills, finishers, items found and Threat Level all raise the amount.

steps.text: Pick one class and keep playing it in Operations until it reaches level 25.
Play on Ruthless when you can, since higher Threat Levels give more XP.
Pick up the @item{Gene-Seed} on the map and finish the mission with it. Falling even once loses it.

achievements.description: Reach the maximum Level for one Melee Weapon
achievements.summary: Level one melee weapon to its maximum.

guide.context: A weapon earns XP when an Operation ends.

steps.text: Choose one melee weapon and keep using it in Operations until it reaches its maximum level.
Finish each mission so the weapon receives its XP.

achievements.description: Reach the maximum Level for one Ranged Weapon
achievements.summary: Level one ranged weapon to its maximum.

guide.context: A weapon earns XP when an Operation ends.

steps.text: Choose one ranged weapon and keep using it in Operations until it reaches its maximum level.
Finish each mission so the weapon receives its XP.

achievements.description: Customise a full Armour set for one Class
achievements.summary: Customise every piece of one class's armour set.

guide.context: The exact trigger is unclear. Changing each armour piece and owning every purple-tier piece for one class may both count, so do both.

steps.text: Pick one class and win Operations or Eternal War matches with that class to unlock its armour.
In the Battle Barge armoury, change every armour piece of that class.
Also collect every purple-tier armour piece for that class.

achievements.description: Find 200 pickups in Operations mode
achievements.summary: Find 200 pickups in Operations mode.

steps.text: In Operations, collect ammo crates, medicae packs, grenade refills and armour boosts.
Smash the green crates in the levels. They can drop more pickups.

achievements.description: Kill 20,000 enemies (all game modes combined)
achievements.summary: Kill 20,000 enemies across all game modes combined.

steps.text: Keep playing the campaign and Operations. Kills from every mode add up.
Tyranid missions with a high-ammo class such as Heavy give kills fastest.

achievements.displayName: Why Is It Always You Three?
achievements.description: Listen to every line of the Chaplain's dialogue.
achievements.summary: Listen to all of the Chaplain's dialogue after the mission where you kill the Chaos sorcerer.

steps.text: After the Chaos sorcerer mission, meet the Chaplain and let all of his dialogue play.

achievements.description: As a Tactical, kill 25 enemies with every available Primary Weapon
achievements.summary: Playing Tactical, get 25 kills with every available primary weapon.

guide.context: The Tactical has 7 primary weapons. If the game offers more, use every one.

steps.text: Play Operations as the @mechanic{Tactical} class.
Use one primary weapon until it has 25 kills, then switch: Bolt Rifle, Heavy Bolt Rifle, Auto Bolt Rifle, Stalker Bolt Rifle, Bolt Carbine, Plasma Incinerator, Melta Rifle.
Swap weapons at the arsenals you find in missions.

achievements.description: As a Sniper, make 250 Headshots
achievements.summary: As a Sniper, make 250 headshots.

steps.text: Play as the Sniper class and aim for the head with the @item{Bolt Sniper Rifle}.

achievements.description: As a Heavy, kill 500 enemies while in Heavy Stance
achievements.summary: Playing Heavy, get 500 kills while standing in Heavy Stance.

steps.text: Play as the Heavy and press the middle mouse button to enter @mechanic{Heavy Stance}.
Get your kills while you stay in that stance until the total reaches 500.

achievements.description: As an Assault, hit 500 total enemies with Ground Pound
achievements.summary: As an Assault, hit 500 enemies in total with Ground Pound.

steps.text: Play as the Assault class and hold Q to rise with the @item{Jump Pack}.
Aim at the middle of a crowd and slam down to hit them with @mechanic{Ground Pound}.
A Thunder Hammer against Tyranid swarms works best.

achievements.description: As a Bulwark, kill 100 enemies with every available Melee Weapon
achievements.summary: Playing Bulwark, get 100 kills with every available melee weapon.

guide.context: The Bulwark has 3 melee weapons. If the game offers more, use every one.

steps.text: Play as the Bulwark class.
Use one melee weapon until it has 100 kills, then switch: Power Sword, Power Fist, Chainsword.

achievements.description: As a Vanguard, perform 100 Gun Strikes
achievements.summary: Playing Vanguard, do 100 Gun Strikes.

steps.text: Play as the Vanguard class. Press Esc to open the combo list and find the combos with a broken-shield icon.
Use one of those combos in a fight to stun an enemy. A held heavy attack on the right mouse button is the easiest.
When a red crosshair shows on a nearby enemy, press the left mouse button to Gun Strike.
A low-level melee weapon on high difficulty also works. Small Tyranids can be Gun Struck after 2 or 3 hits.

achievements.description: Force a Ravener to release a grabbed Squad Member
achievements.summary: Make a Ravener let go of a squad member it has grabbed.

steps.text: Fight @enemy{Raveners}. One can burrow, resurface, and grab a squad member.
While your squad member is held, empty your weapon into the Ravener until it lets go.
This takes luck, or a teammate who does not dodge the grab.

achievements.description: Bring down a Lictor before it attacks from an ambush
achievements.summary: Take down a Lictor before the Lictor can strike from ambush.

guide.context: A Lictor is invisible and stays out of melee range until it attacks.

steps.text: Fight a @enemy{Lictor}. The first one is in @loc{Mission 2: Severance}.
Shoot the Lictor as soon as it shows up, before it hits anyone, until it falls.

achievements.description: Kill a Lesser Sorcerer while he's reviving a Rubric Marine
achievements.summary: Kill a Lesser Sorcerer while he is reviving a Rubric Marine.

steps.text: Find a @enemy{Lesser Sorcerer} in the campaign, from Mission 4 or 5 onward.
When he turns into a bright blue ball to revive a Rubric Marine, kill him.

achievements.description: Break a Scarab Occult Terminator's Melee Combo Attack with 2 Perfect Parries in a row
achievements.summary: Interrupt a Scarab Occult Terminator's melee combo by landing 2 Perfect Parries back to back.

guide.context: This enemy appears in Mission 6: Dawn's Descent and in Mission 7.

steps.text: Find the Scarab Occult Terminator that fights with two curved swords.
Time your block to its attack pattern and @mechanic{Perfect Parry} two of its swings in a row.

achievements.description: Kill 100 enemies using environmental hazards
achievements.summary: Kill 100 enemies with environmental hazards.

steps.text: Shoot red and blue explosive barrels when enemies stand near them.
Repeat across missions until the total reaches 100.

achievements.description: Kill 5 enemies while they are conducting a Call for Reinforcements
achievements.summary: Kill 5 enemies while they are calling for reinforcements.

steps.text: Watch for a skull icon by an enemy's name. The icon fills with red as the call builds.
Kill that enemy before the icon fills.
Larger Tyranids and Chaos enemies make this call.

achievements.description: Kill 1000 Tyranids in Operations mode
achievements.summary: Kill 1000 Tyranids in Operations mode.

steps.text: Play Tyranid Operations such as @loc{Operation 01: Inferno}, @loc{Operation 02: Decapitation} and @loc{Operation 06: Ballistic Engine}.
Operation: Burnout is a good pick, with about 400 kills in one run.

achievements.description: Kill 1000 Chaos servants in Operations mode
achievements.summary: Defeat 1000 Chaos servants while playing Operations.

steps.text: Chaos Operations work best. @loc{Operation 03: Vox Liberatis} has the largest Chaos crowds, around 300 kills in one run.

achievements.displayName: Still a True Son of the Emperor
achievements.description: Kill 41,000 Enemies (all game modes combined)
achievements.summary: Kill 41,000 enemies across all game modes combined.

steps.text: Start @loc{Mission 1: Skyfire} in the campaign and advance to the group of soldiers who need reinforcements.
When the soldiers say to fall back, reload the last checkpoint.
Repeat. This gives 150 to 250 kills per minute.

achievements.description: Win any match in Eternal War mode
achievements.summary: Win one Eternal War match.

steps.text: Join any Eternal War match, in Annihilation, Capture and Control, or Seize Ground, and win.

achievements.description: Win a match in Eternal War mode with every Class
achievements.summary: Win an Eternal War match with each of the 6 classes.

steps.text: Win a match as each class: Tactical, Assault, Vanguard, Bulwark, Sniper and Heavy.
After a win, switch to a class you have not won with.

achievements.description: Play 10 Annihilation matches in Eternal War mode
achievements.summary: Join 10 Annihilation games in the Eternal War mode.

steps.text: Choose Annihilation from the Battle Barge and play 10 matches.

achievements.description: Play 10 Capture and Control matches in Eternal War mode
achievements.summary: Join 10 Capture and Control games in the Eternal War mode.

steps.text: Choose Capture and Control from the Battle Barge and play 10 matches.

achievements.description: Play 10 Seize Ground matches in Eternal War mode
achievements.summary: Join 10 Seize Ground games in the Eternal War mode.

steps.text: Choose Seize Ground from the Battle Barge and play 10 matches.

achievements.description: Achieve a streak of 5 kills without dying in Eternal War mode
achievements.summary: Kill 5 enemies in a row without dying in Eternal War mode.

steps.text: Pick a class you play well. Sniper is the easiest because of its high damage and cloak.
Stay with your group, retreat after each kill, and let armour and health recover.
Target wounded enemies and lightly armoured classes.

achievements.description: Overcome every challenge and achieve ultimate victory
achievements.summary: Unlock the other 49 achievements.

guide.context: The achievement can appear late after you unlock the last other one.

steps.text: Unlock the other 49 achievements. This one then unlocks on its own.
